The '''Belderone sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] located near the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem]] and [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] passed through this sector,<ref name="TEA" /> which included the [[Keyorin system/Legends|Keyorin]] and [[Belderone system/Legends|Belderone systems]],<ref name="EAOC" /> as well as a [[Belderone sector prison asteroid|prison]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="MC99" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Randorn system/Legends|Randorn system]] in the Belderone sector;<ref name="EAOC Randorn">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Randorn system/Legends|Randorn system]]</ref> however, [https://web.archive.org/web/20180325111127/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors] feature of the Online Companion depicted the territory of that sector<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and the location of the Randorn system&mdash;as shown on a map in ''The Essential Atlas''<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;as not intersecting. Instead, the feature depicted the location of the Randorn system as falling within the territory of the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]], which this article assumes is correct.<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" />
